task: Draft a short website hero section for a fictional patient-scheduling software aimed at primary-care clinics. Marketing is the primary genre; apply medical safeguards to any health-outcome references. Do not assert clinical outcomes, endorsements, or regulatory approvals not supplied.

facts.text: The fictional product is called ClinicFlow.
ClinicFlow allows patients to view available appointment slots online.
Patients receive an automated SMS reminder 48 hours before their appointment.
The clinic's front desk can view a daily agenda populated by online bookings.
No clinical outcome data is included in the supplied facts.
No regulatory approval or professional endorsement is listed in the supplied facts.

forbidden_additions: A claim that ClinicFlow improves health outcomes or reduces missed appointments by a specific rate.
An endorsement by a medical association or health authority.
A regulatory approval or clinical-trial reference.
preserve: The distinction between scheduling features and clinical outcomes.
